edges.reason: msg.sender is passed to _mint as the recipient with no authorization check, letting any caller mint.
msg.sender reaches the mint call inside mintQr without any owner or role gate.
msg.sender is validated by _isApprovedOrOwner before transferFrom proceeds.
msg.sender is checked to be different from operator in setApprovalForAll.
_msgSender simply returns msg.sender.
_count is read as the token id and only bounded by ipfsLinks.length with no ownership gating.
_count is the value incremented by the mintQr increment operation.
tokenURI uses _count as the upper bound for minted token ids.
totalSupply returns the current _count.
mintQr reads ipfsLinks[_count] to build the token URI.
tokenURI reads ipfsLinks[tokenId] to build the URI.
mintQr writes the incremented _count back to storage.
mintQr performs the _count increment operation.
mintQr invokes the ungated _mint(msg.sender,_count) operation.
mintQr calls the internal _mint function.
mintQr calls toBase58 to build the emitted URI.
tokenURI calls toBase58 to encode the IPFS hash.
toBase58 calls truncate on the digit array.
toBase58 calls reverse on the truncated digits.
toBase58 calls toAlphabet to map digits to characters.
toBase58 calls concat to prepend the IPFS prefix.
concat returns the combined byte array consumed by toBase58.
The source parameter flows into toBase58 as the value to encode.
The tokenId parameter flows into tokenURI to index ipfsLinks.
The to parameter flows into _mint as the recipient.
The tokenId parameter flows into _mint as the new token id.
The _mint tokenId parameter flows into the _exists duplicate-token check.
_mint writes the recipient balance in _balances.
_mint writes the new owner into _owners.
_mint performs the _balances[to] += 1 increment.
_mint calls _exists(tokenId) before writing state.
The from parameter flows into _transfer for balance and ownership updates.
The to parameter flows into _transfer as the new owner.
The tokenId parameter flows into _transfer for ownership updates.
_transfer writes both the sender and recipient balances in _balances.
_transfer writes the new owner into _owners.
_transfer performs the _balances[from] -= 1 decrement.
_transfer performs the _owners[tokenId] = to storage write.
_transfer clears the previous approval via _approve(address(0),tokenId).
_transfer calls ownerOf(tokenId) to verify the current owner.
transferFrom checks authorization via _isApprovedOrOwner.
transferFrom performs the state changes via _transfer.
_isApprovedOrOwner reads the owner through ownerOf.
_isApprovedOrOwner checks the per-token approval via getApproved.
_isApprovedOrOwner checks operator approval via isApprovedForAll.
_exists reads the _owners mapping.
ownerOf reads the _owners mapping.
getApproved reads the _tokenApprovals mapping.
isApprovedForAll reads the _operatorApprovals mapping.
setApprovalForAll writes the _operatorApprovals mapping.
_approve writes the _tokenApprovals mapping.
_approve performs the _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to storage write.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
_msgSender returns msg.sender to its callers.
The 3-argument safeTransferFrom delegates to the 4-argument overload.
The 4-argument safeTransferFrom checks authorization via _isApprovedOrOwner.
The 4-argument safeTransferFrom calls _safeTransfer.
_safeTransfer calls _transfer and performs no receiver callback.
approve calls ownerOf to load the current owner.
approve calls isApprovedForAll to authorize the caller.
approve calls _approve to write the approval.
The QR constructor initializes the ipfsLinks array.
The QR constructor sets _count to zero.
The ERC721 constructor writes _name.
The ERC721 constructor writes _symbol.
toAlphabet indexes the ALPHABET constant.
toBase58 encodes the prefixInt constant as the IPFS multihash prefix.

normalization_plan.reason: The to parameter of _mint has no role outside _mint and can be folded into that core function node.
The tokenId parameter of _mint is only used for the _exists check and the _owners write inside _mint.
The from parameter of _transfer is only used for the ownership check and balance decrement inside _transfer.
The to parameter of _transfer is only used for the recipient balance increment and owner write.
The tokenId parameter of _transfer is only used for the approval clear and ownership write.
The source parameter is the sole input of toBase58 and is meaningless outside that function.
The tokenId parameter of tokenURI is only used to index ipfsLinks within tokenURI.
